Package org.zvec.binding

Class MultiQuery

java.lang.Object
org.zvec.binding.MultiQuery
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class MultiQuery extends Object implements AutoCloseable
High-level wrapper for zvec_multi_query_t.

Combines multiple SubQuery instances (e.g., vector + FTS) and supports re-ranking strategies such as RRF and weighted fusion.
